labels.报表已改为按报表授权：请联系系统管理员，在「角色管理」里为你的角色勾选需要的报表: Reports are now granted per report. Ask a system administrator to enable the ones your role needs under Role management.
labels.不选人的话，这条纪要只有你自己和系统管理员能看到: If no one is picked, only you and system admins can see this minute
labels.「全校」按年级适用；「学习领域」按部门（学科组）适用: “Whole School” applies by grade; “Learning Area” applies by department (subject group)
labels.「建议保留」是信息最全、创建最早的那条，仅供参考；合并动作请在卫瓴系统里完成，本: “Keep this one” is the most complete and earliest-created record and is for reference only; merging is done in Weiling — this report only produces the checklist.
labels.「班内排名」按每个学生自己的班级分别计算；跨班比较请用总排名。: Class rank is computed within each student’s own class; use the overall rank when comparing across classes.
labels.一个学生一条记录；多学生同一次事件用「批次号」关联。告警由这些记录自动重算得出，: One record per student; for a single event involving several students, link them with the same Batch No. Alerts are recalculated automatically from these records and never entered by hand.
labels.一次提交一个版本；是否迟交由服务端按「截止时间 vs 提交时间」核算，无需手填: One version per submission; lateness is computed server-side from due time vs submitted time — no manual entry
labels.一节课 2~3 条，写「学生能做到什么」: 2–3 per lesson, phrased as what students will be able to do
labels.与「学生可见」是两个独立开关，可只对一方可见: Independent of Visible to Student; you may make it visible to only one side.
labels.与「提交时间」一起决定是否迟交: Together with Submitted At, decides whether the submission is late
labels.仅管理员可见，无需授权: Visible to admins only — no grant needed
labels.以单个学生为中心，汇总其全生命周期记录（M1 学生域）: Centered on a single student, aggregating their full-lifecycle records (M1 Student Domain)
labels.使用邮箱「授权码」而非登录密码；编辑时若显示 •••••• 或留空，表示保留原密: Use the mailbox "app password" instead of the login password; when editing, •••••• or a blank field means the current password is kept
labels.先把「学生 × 批次 × 科目」的总评按学生聚合成一行，再排名 —— 否则同一个: Term grades (student × batch × subject) are aggregated to one row per student before ranking — otherwise a single student would take several top spots.
labels.入学年级与当前年级对比，看学生升级流动: Entry vs current grade, showing student progression
labels.全局搜索：学生 / 教师 / 课程 / 教学班: Global search: students / teachers / courses / teaching classes
labels.关键写操作（创建/更新/删除）留痕，仅系统内部记录，不可修改（需审计权限）: Critical write operations (create/update/delete) are logged; internal-only and immutable (audit permission required)
labels.冗余存一份，便于按单元直接筛部署记录: Stored redundantly so deployed records can be filtered by unit directly
labels.写清「学生能做到什么」，便于单元改写时对齐口径: State what students will be able to do, so unit-level rewording stays aligned
labels.写清本单元要解决的核心问题与达成标准: State the core question this unit addresses and the mastery criteria
labels.出勤率 = 实到 ÷ 应出勤人次，只统计「已通过」终态的考勤记录；: Attendance rate = present ÷ expected attendance, counting only approved final-state records;
labels.出勤率、迟到/请假/缺勤次数排行与趋势: Attendance rate, late/leave/absence ranking and trend
labels.创建 / 编辑智能体并绑定飞书应用，实现「每个智能体对应一个飞书机器人」。: Create / edit agents and bind Feishu apps — one Feishu bot per agent.
labels.加权 GPA = 各科加权 GPA 的平均（科目等权，ACMS 不做学分制）；没: Weighted GPA is the mean of the per-subject weighted GPA (subjects are equally weighted; ACMS has no credit system). Subjects without grade points are excluded.
labels.单元内的教学环节；「排序」决定部署到课次时的先后顺序: Teaching blocks inside a unit; Order decides the sequence when deploying to sessions
labels.单元在某教学班的开课区间；填好起止日期后点行内「部署环节到课次」即可排完整个单元: The date range over which this unit runs for a teaching class; set the dates, then use “Deploy Blocks to Sessions” on the row to schedule the whole unit
labels.单元母版挂在课程方案上，可复用到不同学年与教学班；环节与成果都挂在单元下: Unit templates hang off a course plan and can be reused across academic years and teaching classes; blocks and outcomes attach to the unit
labels.单发 / 批量发送与回执状态机（M4 通知闭环）。新建/编辑时进入独立表单，顶部: Single / batch sending with a delivery receipt state machine (M4 Notification Loop). Creating or editing opens a standalone form; the "Create" and "Search" buttons are hidden from the top bar.
labels.卫瓴侧已按手机号去重，有手机号的记录不会重复，所以清单集中在没有手机号的记录里；: Weiling already deduplicates by phone number, so records with a phone never repeat — the list therefore concentrates on records without one;
labels.及格线固定为 60 分；达标率按等级的序号判定（序号越小越好），未设目标的记录不: The pass line is fixed at 60. Attainment uses the level order (lower is better); rows without a target are excluded from the numerator.
labels.双击编辑；拖拽或点击上下箭头排序: Double-click to edit; drag or click the up/down arrows to reorder
labels.只列出最近 200 个课次；课次本身在「排课课次」页维护: Only the 200 most recent sessions are listed; sessions themselves are maintained on the Sessions page
labels.只列出最近 300 条教案: Only the 300 most recent lesson entries are listed
labels.只统计已通过终态且计入统计的记录: Counts only approved final-state records that are included in statistics
labels.只记「完成与否 + 教师确认」，不含分数；分数走成绩册: Records completion and teacher confirmation only — no marks; marks belong to the markbook
labels.可添加多个。点「一键填入本机 WiFi」自动读取（需先运行 node scrip: You can add multiple. Click "Auto-fill this device's WiFi" to read it automatically (requires running node scripts/wifi-helper.mjs first and opening this page via local dev http://localhost:3000); or manually enter the SSID of the WiFi network this device is currently connected to.
labels.可添加多个（选填，用于更严格的 WiFi 校验）: You can add multiple (optional, for stricter WiFi validation)
labels.右侧主内容区域背景色预览: Right Main Content Area Background Preview
labels.同一份作业的多次提交依次递增，1 为初稿: Increments for repeat submissions of the same homework; 1 is the first draft
labels.同一组内如果出现 2 个以上不同手机号，会被判定为不同的人，不列入清单（换号的同: If a group contains two or more different phone numbers, its members are treated as different people and excluded (someone who changed their number may therefore be missed);
labels.同一范围内按此升序展示: Displayed ascending within the same scope
labels.同一课程方案内按此升序: Ascending order within the same course plan
labels.含未标注审核状态的记录，未标注的不支持下钻: Includes records with no review status; unlabelled ones cannot be drilled into
labels.在校人数、性别比、新生占比等核心指标: Enrollment, gender ratio and new-student share
labels.填了才能在「课程规划」里按单元汇总这一节的归属: Required for this lesson to roll up under its unit in Curriculum
labels.多个标签用逗号分隔；保存后会整体替换原有标签: Separate multiple tags with commas; saving replaces all existing tags
labels.多个用「、」分隔（文件先传到网盘再贴链接）: Separate multiple links with “、” (upload files to the drive first, then paste the links)
labels.多学生同一次事件（如一起打闹）填同一个批次号，便于回溯整件事: For one event involving several students (e.g. a scuffle), use the same batch number so the whole event can be traced.
labels.多数邮箱与邮箱地址相同: Usually identical to the email address
labels.大一中国经济与社会转型: Year 1 Chinese Economy and Social Transformation
labels.如 2026-2027；按学年检索用顶部搜索框: e.g. 2026-2027; use the search box at the top to search by academic year
labels.如 课堂纪律 / 作业提交 / 文明礼貌；自由文本，同一口径写同一种叫法: e.g. Classroom discipline / Homework submission / Politeness. Free text — keep the wording consistent for the same kind of issue.
labels.如「七年级数学 · 第一章 有理数」；它也是部署环节列表里显示的开课名: e.g. “Grade 7 Math · Chapter 1 Rational Numbers”; this is also the class name shown in the deployed blocks list
labels.如：一周后回访，观察课堂表现: e.g. Follow up in a week and observe classroom behaviour.
labels.如：与家长电话沟通，家长表示会配合监督作业: e.g. Spoke with the parent by phone; the parent agreed to help supervise homework.
labels.如：已核对打卡记录，同意计入出勤: e.g. Checked the clock-in record; approved for attendance
labels.姓名栏的占位符（--、未知）与「王先生」这类宽泛称呼不参与判定，否则会聚出大量假: Placeholders such as “--” or “未知” and vague salutations like “王先生” are ignored, otherwise they would produce a large number of false groups;
labels.学生个性化发展计划（IDP）：人生平衡轮、目标与行动、阶段成果与展示路演（M1: Individual Development Plan (IDP): life balance wheel, goals and actions, stage outcomes and showcase roadshow (M1 Student Domain)
labels.学生日常跟进与待办闭环（M1 学生域）: Student daily follow-up & to-do loop (M1 Student domain)
labels.审核后成为终态：只有「已通过」的考勤记录才计入出勤率与结算基数，「已驳回」与「待: Reviewing sets the final state: only Approved records count towards the attendance rate and the billing base — Rejected and Pending do not.
labels.客观描述发生了什么，家长信件的明细直接取这段文字: Describe objectively what happened; the parent letter detail is taken directly from this text.
labels.家长/学生通过微信小程序、家长 H5 登录后的绑定记录。可解绑（移除绑定并强制下: Binding records for parents/students who signed in via WeChat Mini Program or the parent H5 page. You can unbind (remove the binding and force offline) or force the current session offline.
labels.家长沟通与待办闭环（M1 学生域）: Parent communication & to-do loop (M1 Student domain)
labels.导出的是当前筛选结果，一行一个联系人: Exports the current filter result, one contact per row
labels.将任一业务表全量导出为 CSV（含 BOM，Excel 可直接打开）。需「导出」: Export any business table to CSV (with BOM, directly openable in Excel). Requires the «Export» permission (export:run).
labels.已有部署记录会被重建。: Existing deployment records will be rebuilt.
labels.平均分 / 中位数 / 及格率按「总评」逐条计算（一个学生一个科目算一条）。: Average / median / pass rate are computed over term grades: one row per student per subject.
labels.应出勤人次与实到由考勤码表配置驱动：方向=在校 计实到，方向=不在校 计未出勤；: Expected and present counts are driven by the attendance-code table: Direction = In school counts as present, Direction = Not in school counts as not present;
labels.建议先在这里收敛菜单，再到下方配置操作权限。: Set the menu whitelist here first, then configure action permissions below.
labels.异常 = 考勤状态为「异常」的记录数，与上述口径正交。: Abnormal = the number of records whose attendance status is Abnormal; orthogonal to the methodology above.
labels.当前无记录，录入后本报表自动出图: has no records yet; charts appear once data is entered
labels.当前条件下没有疑似重复的联系人: No suspected duplicates under the current filters
labels.当前角色可以查看本报表，但没有「联系人管理」的查看权限，因此不能下钻到名单。需要: Your role can view this report but has no permission to open Contact Management, so drilling down to the contact list is unavailable. Ask an administrator to grant it in the role permissions.
labels.当前账号没有新增跟进的权限: Your account does not have permission to add follow-ups.
labels.待审核 / 已驳回的记录单独计数，不进分子分母。: Pending and rejected records are counted separately and enter neither the numerator nor the denominator.
labels.微信 openid（小程序）或 parent_<学生ID>（家长 H5）: WeChat openid (Mini Program) or parent_<StudentID> (Parent H5)
labels.必须晚于开始日期: Must be later than the start date
labels.成果库：全校范围按年级、学习领域按部门（学科组）维护；单元与课时从这里挂成果: Outcome library: whole-school outcomes by grade, learning-area outcomes by department (subject group); units and lessons attach outcomes from here
labels.所选条件下暂无考勤记录: No attendance records under the selected filters
labels.所选条件下没有缺勤或迟到记录: No absences or late records under the selected filters
labels.所选条件下没有记录: No records under the selected filters
labels.把学习成果挂到具体一节课上；需要贴合本节内容时在「成果改写」里写单元口径: Attach learning outcomes to a specific lesson; when the wording must fit this lesson, rewrite it under Reworded Outcome
labels.把学习成果挂到单元上；需要贴合本单元口径时在「成果改写」里写: Attach learning outcomes to a unit; when the wording must fit this unit, rewrite it under Reworded Outcome
labels.把该开课所属单元的环节按顺序部署到教学班的课次上？: Deploy this unit's blocks, in order, onto the teaching class sessions?
labels.招生线索与跟进闭环（M1 学生域）: Admission leads & follow-up loop (M1 Student domain)
labels.挂在课次上的备课记录：目标 / 内容 / 活动流程，以及学生与家长是否可见: Lesson preparation attached to a session: objectives, content, activity flow, and student/parent visibility
labels.按「环节 — 时长 — 师生活动」逐行写: One line per “block — duration — teacher/student activity”
labels.按告警等级生成（提醒 / 警告 / 严重警告），正文由服务端按模板与行为事实生成: Generated by alert level (Reminder / Warning / Serious Warning). The body is produced by the server from a template plus the behaviour facts; the system does not send it, so delivery status is maintained manually.
labels.按字段统计缺失率，定位待补录的字段与学生: Missing rate by field, locate fields and students to complete
labels.按学科/学期统计均分、及格率、等级分布: Average, pass rate and grade distribution by subject/term
labels.按教学班汇总单元数与环节部署情况；「部署率」= 已挂到具体课次的环节 ÷ 该班所: Units and block deployment rolled up per teaching class; Deployment Rate = blocks scheduled onto sessions ÷ all blocks across that class's units.
labels.按班级与年级汇总行为条数与告警数；告警口径：负向分值累计 ≥ 5/10/20 分: Summarises behaviour and alert counts by class and grade. Alert rule: accumulated negative points ≥ 5/10/20, or ≥ 3 negative records — the highest tier met applies.
labels.排名用竞赛法：同分同名次，下一名跳号（1、1、3）。与期末总评页里的排名口径一致: Ranks use the competition method: ties share a rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3). Same rule as the term-grade page.
labels.搜索学生姓名 / 描述 / 行为分类 / 地点 / 批次号: Search student name / description / category / location / batch no.
labels.搜索学生姓名 / 收件家长 / 信件正文: Search student name / recipient parent / letter body
labels.搜索学生姓名 / 班级 / 触发原因: Search student name / class / trigger reason
labels.搜索成果名称 / 简称 / 描述: Search outcome name / short name / description
labels.数据源是「期末总评」的结转快照，不是成绩册的原始条目 —— 与成绩单口径一致。: The source is the rolled term-grade snapshot, not the raw markbook entries — so it matches the report card exactly.
labels.新增选项，回车确认: Add Option, press Enter to confirm
labels.日常出勤与异常记录（M1 学生域）: Daily attendance & exception records (M1 Student domain)
labels.暂无可选值（学生表里该字段还没有数据）: No options available (this field has no data yet)

labels.由行为记录重算得出的派生结果：负向分值累计达标或负向条数达标即产生；累计与条数都: Derived by recalculating behaviour records: raised when accumulated negative points or the number of negative records reaches the threshold; when both fall below the mild threshold it is automatically released (history is kept).

labels.留空时自动取学生的「当前班级」: Left blank, the student's Current Class is used.
labels.留空表示直接用成果库原文；要贴合本节内容时在此改写: Leave blank to use the library wording; rewrite here to fit this lesson
labels.疑似同一个人的多条联系人记录：按置信度分组 + 列出证据 + 标注建议保留，可导: Suspected same-person contact records: grouped by confidence, with evidence and a suggested record to keep; exportable as a checklist
labels.列表默认只显示「较可信及以上」，少掉的那些就是「仅参考」: The list shows “Likely and above” by default; the missing groups are the “Reference only” ones

labels.点击查看这批联系人记录: Click to view these contact records
labels.第一个选项（可选，留空则创建空字典）: First option (optional; leave empty to create an empty dictionary)
labels.等级表还没有配「绩点」，所以 GPA 与排名都是空的。到「成绩等级」里给每个等级: The grade scale has no grade points yet, so GPA and ranks are empty. Set a grade point (and tick “Counts to GPA”) for each level under Grade Scales, then roll again.
labels.管理系统账号：分配飞书登录身份、系统角色、数据密级与校区。仅系统管理员可操作。: Manage system accounts: assign Feishu identity, system role, data classification and campus. Admin only.
labels.精确到分钟；只填「发生日期」也能统计，两者都填时以「发生时间」为准: Accurate to the minute. Occurrence Date alone is enough for statistics; when both are filled, Occurrence Time wins.
labels.系统不会真的发信；人工发完后把状态改为「已发送」并填上时间: No email is actually sent; after sending manually, set the status to Sent and fill in the time.
labels.系统管理员不受数据范围限制，此处仅作展示: System admins are exempt from data scope; shown for reference only
labels.系统自动留存的招生与国外学校往来邮件（即使员工离职或邮箱删除，记录仍保留可查）。: System-archived admissions emails with overseas schools (retained and searchable even if staff leave or the mailbox is deleted).
labels.结束时间须晚于开始时间: End time must be later than start time
labels.编辑导航菜单的分组、上下级关系、名称、图标与权限，保存后刷新页面生效。: Edit navigation menu groups, hierarchy, names, icons and permissions; refresh the page after saving to apply.
labels.考勤状态=异常的记录数: Number of records whose attendance status is Abnormal
labels.考勤码表当前为空，出勤率按内置默认码（出勤/迟到/早退/事假/病假/缺勤/校内活: The attendance-code table is empty, so the built-in defaults (present / late / early leave / personal leave / sick leave / absent / on-campus activity) are used — once codes are configured, the table takes precedence.
labels.考勤记录来自学生打卡与教师补录；有记录后这里会自动出图: Attendance records come from student check-ins and teacher entry; charts appear automatically once there is data
labels.考勤记录超过统计上限，本次只统计了前 3 万条: Attendance records exceed the statistics cap; only the first 30,000 were counted
labels.英美文学导论: Introduction to British and American Literature
labels.计入统计=否 的考勤码（如校内活动）整条排除在分子分母之外。: Attendance codes with Counted = No (e.g. on-campus activities) are excluded from both numerator and denominator entirely.
labels.计入统计=否 的考勤码，或码表认不出口径的记录: Records whose attendance code has Counted = No, or whose code cannot be mapped to a scope
labels.记录了处理动作与结果，重算告警不会覆盖这里: Records the action taken and the outcome; alert recalculation never overwrites this.
labels.设为「停用」后该环节不参与部署，也不计入覆盖率的环节总数: Once set to Disabled, the block is excluded from deployment and from the coverage block total
labels.设为「是」后学生门户才能看到这一节的教案: Students can only see this lesson plan in the student portal when set to Yes
labels.评价等级分布、按周期变化趋势: Rating distribution and trend by period
labels.该单元还没有环节: This unit has no blocks yet
labels.该告警同一档已生成过信件: A letter of this level already exists for this alert.
labels.该告警已解除，无法生成家长通知: This alert has been resolved, so a parent letter cannot be generated.
labels.该班级在该批次下还没有总评记录: No term grades for this class in this batch
labels.该记录未关联学生，无法重算告警: This record is not linked to a student, so alerts cannot be recalculated.
labels.语义范围=在校-迟到 计迟到、=离校-提前 计早退、=离校 计请假，其余不在校记: Scope = In school-late counts as late, = Left-early counts as early leave, = Left counts as leave; all other not-in-school codes count as absence;

labels.负向行为填负数或正数都可以，告警按绝对值累计；正向行为不计入告警: Negative behaviour may be entered as a negative or a positive number; alerts accumulate by absolute value. Positive behaviour is not counted.
labels.跟随角色 = 按所属角色的数据范围；全部学生 = 例外放宽（临时跨班查看）；自定: Follow role = use the role scope; All students = exception (cross-class access); Custom = set for this account only

labels.还没有结转过的班级不会出现在这里 —— 先去「考试与成绩」里点一键结转。: Classes that have never been rolled do not show up here — run “Roll term grades” under Exam & Grades first.
labels.还没有行为记录：先到「行为记录」里录一条，统计才有数据。: No behaviour records yet. Add one under Behaviour Records first, then statistics will have data.
labels.这些权限点没有模块归属，仍被部分自建接口使用（知识库、智能助手等）。没有特殊需要: These permissions have no owning module and are still checked by a few custom endpoints (knowledge base, AI assistant, etc.). No change needed unless you have a specific reason.
labels.选学生后，列表用的「学生姓名 / 班级」由服务端自动补齐: After a student is selected, the Student Name / Class shown in lists are filled in by the server automatically.
labels.部署只取这个区间内的课次: Deployment only picks sessions inside this range

labels.部署时自动取课次日期，也可手工调整: Filled from the session date on deploy, and can be adjusted manually
labels.部门会议记录与决议闭环（组织管理域）: Department meeting records & decision loop (Organization domain)
labels.配置各校区 GPS 打卡中心点（WGS-84 经纬度）与允许 WiFi（SSID: Configure GPS check-in centers (WGS-84 lat/lng) and allowed WiFi (SSID/BSSID) per campus; mobile check-in validates by nearest fence + WiFi (see docs/student-portal-plan §6)
labels.配置招生人员的邮箱 IMAP 接入（密码以 AES 加密入库）。系统每 15 分: Configure IMAP access for admissions staff mailboxes (passwords stored AES-encrypted). The system fetches mail automatically every 15 minutes per configured frequency and retains all correspondence.
labels.配置登录后工作台的侧边栏、顶部导航栏、主内容区配色、Logo 与品牌文字，右侧实: Configure the sidebar, top nav bar, main content area colors, logo and brand text of the post-login workspace; live preview on the right and save.
labels.配置登录页的布局、配色、Logo、文案与字体，右侧实时预览并保存。: Configure the login page layout, colors, logo, copy and fonts; live preview on the right and save.
labels.重复只可能出现在这些里面: Duplicates can only hide among these
labels.驳回必须填写审核意见: A review comment is required when rejecting
labels.默认「学生姓名 家长」，可直接改成具体称呼: Defaults to “Student Name Parent”; change it to the actual form of address.
labels.决定该角色能查看哪些学生的档案。⚠️ 两个维度都不勾 = 该角色看不到任何学生；: Determines which students this role can view. ⚠️ No dimension checked = this role sees NO students; tick “Unrestricted” to grant all. Dims are AND-ed; multiple values within a dim are OR-ed.
labels.⚠️ 该角色将看不到任何学生档案；要放开请勾「不限制（看全部学生）」或勾选年级/: ⚠️ This role will see no student records. Tick “Unrestricted” or check grades/statuses to grant access.
labels.个账号；密级低于字段密级的人，看到的是打码值: accounts; anyone below a field level sees the masked value
labels.保存后立即对全站生效（列表、详情、导出、写库剔除）。共: Takes effect immediately across the app (list, detail, export, write-strip).
labels.取该模块一条真实记录，按上面的密级跑一遍脱敏；不显示未受控字段: Runs masking on one real record of this module at the level selected above; uncontrolled fields are hidden.
labels.该模块暂时取不到记录（表为空或无字段元数据）: No record available for this module yet (empty table or no field metadata)
labels.该模块还没有受控字段: This module has no controlled fields yet
labels.该表还没有字段元数据（未初始化过）: This table has no field metadata yet
labels.配置哪些字段在密级不足时被打码或隐藏。用户的有效密级取「用户表 · 数据密级上限: Choose which fields get masked or hidden when the viewer’s level is lower. A user’s effective level comes from the user table field “数据密级上限”; below a field’s level that field is masked in lists, detail and exports, and is never written back with a masked value.
labels.（读不到用户列表，不影响下方配置）: (user list unavailable; the config below still works)
labels.人已单独设置个人密级，其实际密级以个人值为准，此处上限对他们不生效。: have a personal level set, which takes precedence over this cap — the cap does not apply to them.

markbook.title: Markbook
markbook.subtitle: Enter assessment marks per grade/class; the weighted total, level and target attainment are computed on the right. Grouping comes from the student profile’s Current Grade / Current Class
markbook.noTypeWeight: No type weights for this class (all counted as 1)
markbook.noClassHint: Neither “Current Grade” nor “Current Class” has a value in student profiles yet — fill it in first
markbook.noStudents: No active students in this group
markbook.weightNote: Total = Σ(normalised × column weight × type weight) ÷ Σ(weights), denominator counts only entered items
markbook.confirmDeleteColumn: Delete assessment column “{name}”? All marks in it will be deleted too.
markbook.fTypeHint: Options come from the Exam Types page. The bracket shows this type’s weight for this class (or the default weight if this class has none)
markbook.hwSyncSubtitle: Write homework completion straight into the markbook — no re-entering by hand
markbook.hwNeedClass: Pick a class above first, then sync homework
markbook.hwModeFillEmptyHint: Only fills cells that are still empty in the markbook; existing marks are left untouched — the safest option.
markbook.hwModeOverwriteHint: Makes the column reflect homework status faithfully: write a mark when done, clear any leftover mark when not. This touches more cells — check the preview first.
markbook.hwBindHint: Once bound, the column shows the homework completion rate; unbinding never touches marks already written
markbook.hwSyncDone: Wrote {filled}, overwrote {overwritten}, cleared {cleared}; skipped {skipped}, left blank {blank}
markbook.hwSummary: Scanned {scanned} · write {filled} · overwrite {overwritten} · clear {cleared} · skip {skipped} · blank {blank}
markbook.hwPreviewFirst: Preview first to see exactly what will be written, then sync
markbook.hwNoteZeroNotGraded: (a score of 0 counts as ungraded — left blank)
markbook.hwWeightNote: What gets written is the score (not a weight); the total is still weighted by column weight × type weight
markbook.hwCatalogFailed: Failed to load the homework catalogue
markbook.hwDirtyBlock: The markbook still has {count} unsaved change(s) — click Save at the top right first, then sync homework. (Syncing refreshes the grid and unsaved changes would be lost.)
markbook.cellInputHint: Accepts: 85 / 85% / level B / excused (* or "excused") / absent ("absent"). Empty = not entered (removes the cell)
markbook.fSubjectHint: Options come from the “Teaching subjects” dictionary. Term grades are split by subject, so pick from this list (edit the list under Dictionaries)
markbook.homeworkBindHint: Link it in the Homework sync panel below
markbook.fTypeEmpty: No exam types yet — create some under Teaching › Exam types first
markbook.fTypeMissing: no longer in the type list
markbook.fTypeWarn: No exam type selected: this column will count toward the term final with weight 1
markbook.fSubjectEmpty: The “Teaching subjects” dictionary is empty — add values under Dictionaries first
markbook.attainUnknown: Not enough data to judge yet (needs a score and a target order)
markbook.targetOrderUnknownHint: This target’s level order does not exist in the grade scale (e.g. 1, while the best level A is 10), so attainment can never be judged. Pick a target level again under Student targets
markbook.subtotalHint: Only numeric scores count (graded / exempt items are skipped)
markbook.grandHint: Denominator = weights of the items actually filled (self-normalising)
markbook.noColumnsYet: No assessment columns yet — use “New column” above
markbook.footNoteFlat: Grouped by exam type; each group ends with the class raw-score subtotal for that type. The summary columns weigh every assessment.
markbook.footNoteTransposed: One row per assessment (same type grouped together); the right edge shows class mean/max/min. Subtotals and the grand total read down each student column.
markbook.footNoteSubjectCols: Grouped by subject; each group ends with that student’s weighted average and grade for the subject (same algorithm as the overall grade, scoped to the subject).
markbook.footNoteSubjectRows: One row per student × subject; headers are exam types; the row ends with that student’s weighted subject total.

teaching.subtitleAttendanceCodes: Configurable codes for attendance: Direction drives statistics, Scope and Counted decide the rate formula; the short code is the identifier referenced by past records
teaching.hintCode: Stable identifier referenced by past attendance records; once used, do not change it (rename the display name instead)
teaching.hintDirection: In school / Not in school: the primary axis for attendance-rate statistics
teaching.hintScope: In school = fully present; In school-late = present but late; Left = fully absent; Left-early = left early
teaching.hintPrefill: Whether the end-of-term status may be carried into the next session automatically
teaching.hintCounted: When off, this code is excluded from both numerator and denominator of the attendance rate (e.g. on-campus activities)
teaching.hintSort: Displayed ascending within the same list
teaching.subtitleExamTypes: Categories of a single assessment: drives column colour, the default second-layer weight, and whether it counts toward the term grade
teaching.hintExamTypeName: Unique. e.g. Homework / Quiz / Unit Test / Midterm Exam / Final Exam / Project. Markbook columns pick from this list, so weight matching never breaks on spelling
teaching.hintExamTypeColor: Click the swatch to pick from the palette, or type #RRGGBB. The markbook column header uses it as a colour block
teaching.hintExamTypeWeight: Global default for the second-layer weight, multiplied by the column weight. Per-class overrides live in Markbook Type Weights
teaching.hintExamTypeCounted: Set to No to exclude the whole category from the term grade (e.g. Classwork) while still recording it
teaching.hintExamTypeSort: Controls the order of type groups in the markbook header
teaching.subtitleExamComments: Reusable comments teachers can apply with one click; leave Subject empty to make a comment universal
teaching.hintCommentText: Inserted verbatim into the comment box; 20–60 characters works best — longer text squeezes the report card layout
teaching.hintCommentSubject: Empty = universal (usable for any subject); otherwise it only appears on that subject’s comment page
teaching.subtitleExamBatches: Batches for term-final consolidation: the date range decides which markbook columns take part, and the rounding / excused / absent rules decide the denominator
teaching.hintBatchName: Any unique, recognisable name, e.g. "2026-2027 Term 1 Final". You pick the batch by this name when consolidating
teaching.hintSchoolYear: Pick from the School year dictionary; edit the list on the Dictionary page
teaching.hintDateRange: Only markbook columns whose assessment date falls inside this range take part; leave empty for no limit
teaching.hintBatchScale: Leave empty to use the grade scale marked as default
teaching.hintRound: Decimal places kept on the final mark; default is one decimal
teaching.hintExcused: How an excused cell counts in the denominator: excluded (default, an excused absence should not drag the average down) or counted as zero
teaching.hintAbsent: How an absent cell counts in the denominator: counted as zero (default, absence has a cost) or excluded
teaching.hintThresholdHigh: Flag scores above this multiple of the class average, e.g. 1.5. Review only — scores are never changed
teaching.hintThresholdLow: Flag scores below this multiple of the class average, e.g. 0.5
teaching.hintThresholdDelta: Flag when a student deviates from their previous score in the same subject by more than this
teaching.subtitleWeights: The second weight layer: a row's weight = the column weight × this table's weight for (class × exam type)
teaching.hintWeightClass: Pick from the list; it must match the markbook grouping (the student profile current grade). Filling in only the teaching class means the weight silently does nothing
teaching.hintWeightType: Options come from the Exam Types page — the same list. Add, rename or remove them there rather than typing here
teaching.hintWeightValue: Multiplied with the column weight. It does not have to total 100: the denominator is the sum of the weights actually taking part, which self-normalises
teaching.hintTeachingClass: Not used for matching yet (teaching classes have no membership); kept for reference only
teaching.subtitleTargets: The per-student targets behind "attained": attained means the level order is ≤ the target order (a lower order is better)
teaching.hintTargetClass: Picking a student auto-fills the class from their profile (current class, falling back to current grade). The markbook looks up targets by class, so a mismatched class means the target never shows up there
teaching.hintTargetOrder: Pick from the grade scale (lower is better; A is best). Attainment means the student’s level order ≤ this value — so it must be a real order in the scale; a number that does not exist there means attainment can never be judged
teaching.hintTargetScore: Display only; the attainment check uses the level order alone
teaching.subtitleGradeLevels: Every band inside a grade scale; the grade points are the only source for GPA and class rank
teaching.subtitleGradeLevelsOf: Current scale: {name}. Every band below belongs to it
teaching.hintLevelValue: The text shown in the markbook, e.g. A / B+ / Excellent / Pass
teaching.hintLevelOrder: Lower is better (1 = best). The markbook's "attained" flag compares it with the student's target order
teaching.hintLevelRange: Used to derive the band from a score (bounds inclusive); leave both empty to assign the band by hand
teaching.hintLevelPoints: The only source for GPA, e.g. 4.0 / 3.7 / 3.3. Without it, GPA and rank stay empty
teaching.hintLevelCounted: Bands set to "No" are skipped in GPA (e.g. Excused / Not graded) and can leave the points blank
teaching.hintLevelConcern: Bands marked "Yes" are highlighted in the markbook and reports (e.g. D and below)
teaching.noScaleYet: No grade scale yet — use "New scale" above
teaching.confirmDeleteScale: Delete this grade scale? Its levels are not removed automatically.
teaching.hintTargetOrderFallback: The grade scale could not be loaded, so enter the order manually (lower is better). ⚠️ It must match an order in the grade scale, otherwise attainment can never be judged
teaching.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete this exam type group? (A group with types cannot be deleted — move the types first)
teaching.errGroupHasTypes: This group still has {count} exam types; deleting it would make them invisible. Move the types to another group first
teaching.noGroupYet: No exam type groups yet — use “New group” above (existing types are auto-assigned to “Default group”)
teaching.subtitleExamTypesOf: Group: {name}. Types below belong to it; disabling the group removes them from the markbook pickers
teaching.subtitleExamTypesStopped: Group “{name}” is disabled ⇒ its types can no longer be picked in the markbook or type weights (existing markbook columns still compute)
teaching.hintExamTypeGroup: Pick a group: terms are switched off group by group — doing it one type at a time always misses one
teaching.wizGroupHint: Types of the selected group are listed below (disabled groups cannot be picked)
teaching.wizNeedClassStep: Pick a class first — weights are configured per class × exam type
teaching.wizNeedGroupStep: Then pick an exam type group
teaching.wizNoTypes: No exam types in this group yet — create them under Exam types
teaching.wizBulkHint: “Fill selected” only fills the boxes — nothing is written until you press Save. Types you did not tick stay untouched.
teaching.wizExistingHint: Types left untouched fall back to the default weight on the Exam types page
teaching.wizNoExisting: No type weights configured for this class yet (all use defaults)
teaching.wizGroupStoppedHint: This group is disabled, so its types cannot be picked in the markbook. To edit their old weights, enable the group again under Exam types; to just clear them, use Delete in the configured list below.
teaching.wizErrBulkNumber: Weight must be a positive number
teaching.wizErrNothing: Give at least one type a weight
teaching.wizConfirmDelete: Delete the weight for “{type}”? (It then falls back to the default weight)

examGrades.title: Exam & Grades
examGrades.subtitle: Roll markbook results into term grades; lock them, then produce report cards and PDFs
examGrades.noBatch: No batch yet (create one under Grade Batches)
examGrades.snapshotNotice: Term grades are a snapshot taken when rolled. Editing the markbook afterwards will not change them — run the roll again to refresh. Confirmed rows are skipped and never overwritten.
examGrades.noTermGrades: Nothing to roll yet. Click “Roll term grades”.
examGrades.gpaNote: Formula: Σ(normalised × column weight × type weight) ÷ Σweights, denominator counts participants only
examGrades.gpaNotConfigured: No grade points configured — GPA hidden
examGrades.gpaNotConfiguredHint: Grade points are not configured on the level table, so GPA is omitted. Set “Grade Point” and “Counts to GPA”, then roll again.
examGrades.itemsHint: Items = assessments that entered the denominator; weight sum = their effective weights (column × type)
examGrades.noTermGradesShort: No term grades in this batch
examGrades.noReportCard: Pick a student on the left (roll term grades first)
examGrades.summaryCommentPlaceholder: Overall comment across all subjects. Saves on blur.
examGrades.commentNotice: Inputs save on blur, so a whole class can be finished on one screen. Confirmed term grades are locked — unconfirm before editing.
examGrades.noTermGradesForComment: No term grades yet (roll term grades first)
examGrades.commentPlaceholder: Write the comment for this subject…
examGrades.excusedHint: {n} item(s) excused and excluded from the denominator
examGrades.absentHint: {n} item(s) marked absent and counted as 0
examGrades.commentLockedHint: Comments on confirmed term grades are locked — unconfirm first
examGrades.anomalyThresholds: Thresholds: high outlier ≥ class avg × {high}, low outlier ≤ × {low}, swing ≥ {swing} points
examGrades.anomalyNoAutoFix: This page only flags — it never changes a score automatically
examGrades.anomalySortHint: Sorted by severity: R1 over-max → R2 zero → outliers → swing
examGrades.anomalyFooter: A wrong score is expensive (parent complaints, reprinted report cards). This table surfaces it right after entry instead of at the end of term.
examGrades.previewSummary: {create} to create · {update} to update · {unchanged} unchanged · {skipped} skipped (confirmed)
examGrades.confirmUndo: Unconfirm “{name}”? Its term grade and comment become editable again.
examGrades.adjustNeedRollFirst: This row was not rolled yet — it has been rolled just now, please click Adjust again
examGrades.commentLocked: This term grade is confirmed, so its comment is locked — unconfirm first
examGrades.settingsMeta: Global defaults · batch-level values win when set
examGrades.settingsNotice: A batch that leaves a field empty inherits the value here, so changing this needs no edits to existing batches.
examGrades.settingsHint: Effective immediately. Already-rolled term grades are not recalculated — roll again from the Term Grades tab.

impersonate.title: Impersonate
impersonate.subtitle: Browse ACMS as any account in the system to diagnose permission and data-scope problems such as “why can’t this teacher see the record”. Every action is logged.
impersonate.warnHighRisk: This is a high-risk operation. While impersonating you can see everything the target user sees and write as them. A persistent banner stays on screen and you can exit at any time.
impersonate.unlockDesc: Enter the administrator password to unlock this page.
impersonate.tipPassword: Configured by the server environment variable IMPERSONATE_PASSWORD; a default is used when unset
impersonate.tipLock: 5 consecutive failures lock this IP for 15 minutes
impersonate.tipLog: Unlocks and enters are recorded in the impersonation log
impersonate.badPasswordRest: {n} attempt(s) left — after that this IP is locked for 15 minutes.
impersonate.lockedDesc: Too many attempts. Try again in {min} minute(s).
impersonate.unlockExpired: Your unlock has timed out. Please enter the password again.
impersonate.lockedBack: Locked. Please enter the password again
impersonate.listMeta: From the system user table · excludes email and phone
impersonate.exitFailed: Failed to exit impersonation, please retry
impersonate.exitExpired: The administrator session has expired and the impersonation session was destroyed — please sign in again
impersonate.nestedDenied: You are already impersonating. You cannot impersonate someone else from here — exit the current impersonation first.
impersonate.enterDesc: You can restrict this impersonation. Restrictions are enforced on the server; buttons stay visible and return a clear error when blocked.
impersonate.enterModulesHint: None selected = no restriction; hold Ctrl / ⌘ to multi-select
impersonate.logsSubtitle: Who entered the system as whom, and when
impersonate.logsNotice: This log answers “who impersonated which accounts last month”. Enters, exits and failed unlocks are all recorded, and records cannot be deleted.
impersonate.logsFooter: Records cannot be deleted — the point of an audit trail is that the operator cannot clean it up.

apiTokens.title: API Tokens
apiTokens.subtitle: Long-lived credentials for the CLI / MCP / scripts. The plaintext is shown once at issue time — only its SHA-256 is stored.
apiTokens.warnHighRisk: A token reads and writes with the bound user's permissions and can live up to a year. Issue on a least-privilege basis: prefer read-only, prefer a module whitelist over full access.
apiTokens.unlockDesc: Tokens grant long-term access, so issuing and revoking both require the administrator password.
apiTokens.pwdDefault: Currently using the in-source default password — set IMPERSONATE_PASSWORD to override
apiTokens.pwdEnv: Configured via the IMPERSONATE_PASSWORD environment variable
apiTokens.tipIssue: Issues, revocations and limit changes are all written to the audit log
apiTokens.noTokens: No tokens yet. Click “Issue token” to start.
apiTokens.footer: “Calls” is a running total. Reads only increment the counter instead of being logged row-by-row — a busy agent would otherwise heat up the database and drown out the audits that matter. Turn on full logging per token when you need it.
apiTokens.issueDesc: A random secret is generated and bound to an account. The token's permissions equal that account's, narrowed by the limits below.
apiTokens.fUserHint: The token inherits this account's roles, campuses and data scope; disabled accounts cannot be used
apiTokens.fExpireHint: Up to one year; defaults to one year from now
apiTokens.expirePast: The expiry must be later than now
apiTokens.expireTooFar: At most one year — no later than {date}
apiTokens.notice: API tokens let CLI / MCP / scripts call ACMS as a specific account. A token's permissions equal that account's, narrowed by the limits below. The plaintext is shown only once — only its hash is stored, so save it before closing this dialog.
apiTokens.fReadOnlyHint: Blocks every write. Keep this on for agent use
apiTokens.fModulesHint: None selected = no restriction. Otherwise only these modules are reachable; anything else returns 403
apiTokens.fIpHint: Empty = any IP. Supports wildcards like 10.0.0.*
apiTokens.fLogAllHint: Also logs reads. By default only writes are logged
apiTokens.fStatusHint: “Disabled” temporarily turns the token off; use Revoke to kill it permanently
apiTokens.onceTitle: This secret will not be shown again
apiTokens.onceWarn: Copy it before closing this card. Only its SHA-256 is stored (we cannot read it back either) — if you lose it, revoke and issue a new one.
apiTokens.editDesc: Takes effect immediately (the server clears its verification cache, so “read-only off but still blocked” cannot happen).
apiTokens.revokePrompt:
Revoke “{name}”? It stops working immediately and cannot be restored — you will need to issue a new one.

Optional reason (written to the audit log):
